properties.headline: High Wind Warning issued October 14 at 6:39PM PDT until October 17 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...For Thursday and Friday northeast winds 25 to 35 mph with
gusts to 55 mph possible. Gusts over 60 mph near the Cajon Pass.
For Saturday, winds will turn more easterly with gusts 35 to 45
mph, strongest below the San Gorgonio Pass.

* WHERE...San Bernardino and Riverside County Valleys-The Inland
Empire.

* WHEN...From 6 AM Thursday to 8 PM PDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Damaging winds could blow down trees and power lines.
Power outages are possible. Travel could be difficult for high
profile vehicles.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds will be strongest on Friday.
properties.instruction:
People are urged to secure loose objects that could be blown around
or damaged by the wind.

NWSheadline: HIGH WIND WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT FROM 6 AM THURSDAY TO 8 PM PDT SATURDAY
